selector.rationale: The presence of a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas in the right buccal space on contrast-enhanced CT supports the diagnosis of a buccal cyst.

rejected.label: Buccal space infection
rejected.why: The absence of pain or fever contradicts the typical presentation of a buccal space infection.

rejected.label: Diabetic cheilitis
rejected.why: The lack of lymphadenopathy, paresthesia, or facial palsy does not support the diagnosis of diabetic cheilitis.

rejected.label: Torus mandibularis
rejected.why: The location and characteristics of the swelling do not match the typical presentation of torus mandibularis.

rejected.label: Stafne bone cavity
rejected.why: Although some imaging features are consistent with Stafne bone cavity, the clinical presentation and histological description better support the diagnosis of a buccal cyst.
